description: We are looking to have time and enhance our coding skills.
summary: Home Alone on Mars focuses on teaching children how to manage a martian outpost by using real factual data directly from nasa. The game prioritizes decision making allowing the children to make educated choices and demonstrating the consequences of that choice. This game was created to teach children fundamental STEM and engineering concepts in a way they can understand and retain.
details: Our project is a game about an astronaut (the player) that has to manage a martian outpost by themselves while their parents are gone. This benefits children to help them retain and learn STEM and engineering concepts in a way that is engaging and teaches them about the consequences of their decisions based on real data. This game can allow children to look through the eyes of what an engineer managing a martian outpost may face in a way they can understand. To create this project we used VScode with node.js. The code was also generated with assistance from Gemini flash. Our project is creative because of our original story line, the mini games we created and the challenges the players may face throughout the game, Our factors we considered were based on our children audience so we prioritized readability, engagement, and enjoyment.
